prompt:
A flat vector infographic card for a technical engineering handbook, light poster style.

Use the reference image for its colour treatment, its ICON DRAWING STYLE, its stroke weights and its typographic feel. IGNORE the reference layout entirely — the layout is specified below.

CRITICAL ICON STYLE: every icon is CRISP FLAT VECTOR — clean geometric shapes, a uniform 2px dark outline, flat solid fill, no sketchy strokes, no wobbly hand-drawn lines, no marker or crayon texture, no rough edges. The coin stacks are precise flat cylinders with even elliptical tops.

GROUND: very light cool grey, colour 234 238 246, plain. The panel is white, colour 255 255 255, with a 2px rounded outline in dark ink, radius 14.
PALETTE BY ROLE: primary ink colour 26 34 48 for the title and every label; rejected attempts marked with a cross in colour 239 68 68; the accepted attempt's tick in colour 20 184 166; the coins filled amber, colour 240 180 41, with a 2px dark outline; the caption in muted grey, colour 110 122 138.
LABEL SIZE — CRITICAL: the labels must be BIG. Every label's letters are about one third as tall as the letters of the title, unmistakably readable when the whole card is shrunk to 360 pixels wide. Labels are monospace, primary ink. The caption at the bottom is smaller than the labels but still clearly legible, about two thirds of the label height.
LAYOUT RULES: compose so the whole card — title, panel, arrow, caption — fills the frame with equal top and bottom margins, and no empty band anywhere.

LAYOUT: title across the top left, bold geometric sans, sentence case, one line. Below it one wide white panel divided by a thin vertical hairline into two halves:
- LEFT HALF: a monospace label at the top, then three separate short stacks of amber coins in a row, all the same height, with a small red cross above the first two stacks and a teal tick above the third, then a monospace label below the row.
- RIGHT HALF: a monospace label at the top, then one single taller stack of amber coins with a teal tick above it, then a monospace label below it.
BELOW the panel, spanning most of the width: a broad red curved arrow sweeping upward from left to right, with a monospace label to the right of its head.
At the very bottom, one short line of small muted grey text.

Render exactly this text and no other words anywhere:
"Cost per accepted answer"
"cheap model"
"3 attempts"
"expensive model"
"1 attempt"
"the retry tax"
"the sticker price is not the unit"

NEGATIVE: no sketchy or hand-drawn line quality; no bar chart, no axes, no equals sign, no percentages, no currency symbols, no numbers other than those listed; never render a colour code or any '#' character; no watermark, no logo, no signature, no extra labels, no legend, no paragraphs, no gibberish micro-text, no misspellings, no duplicated words, no emoji, no photorealism, no 3D render, no gradients, no drop shadows.
